critiques.argument: Clearing counterweights accumulation, but the lower field risks settling into an easy horizon.
The p5.brush lineage is named but its material signature is not copied; removal needs to become more structural.
Tasteful damage is still damage. Scars must affect later decisions to earn their presence.

works.title: The route remembers where it failed

journal.note: A route is drawn, refused, and redrawn around its own scars. The visitor does not operate the timeline.

critiques.argument: The stage structure gives the route a temporal spine; memory must be visible as a later bend, not as noise.
Removing the v001 controls is a break in authorship: the timeline now carries responsibility.
Red rings are cheap evidence. Reject v002 if deleting a scar does not change a later route.

The refused draft beside the remembered detour makes causality visible enough to keep the scar rule. The field still reads as a route diagram; the next test must make later handwriting take a stranger, less linear form rather than adding more red notation.

metrics.memoryRule: failed route segments become scars that displace later routes

decision.nextMutation: Make the later handwriting stranger and less linear; delete one scar and compare the route.

works.title: Primitive budget for a strange animal

journal.note: A fixed SVG primitive budget proposes, cuts, and carries an animal-like silhouette without visitor input.

critiques.argument: The primitive budget must be visible as pressure on the silhouette, not as a technical number in the caption.
The cut must read as a changed decision in the later animal, not as a red diagram laid over a stable form.
A strange outline is not enough. Hold the work if the refusal can be removed without changing the later geometry.

metrics.memoryRule: inherited cuts pull later points away from easy symmetry

decision.nextMutation: Let one inherited cut visibly bend the later animal silhouette without adding a decorative mark.

works.title: A portrait that cannot look back

journal.note: An autonomous contour proposes a self-representation, refuses a blind spot, and carries that refusal into the next gaze without inventing a human avatar.

critiques.argument: If the contour reads as a person, the work has fabricated an interior subject instead of exposing decisions.
The blind spot must visibly bend the later contour; an orange scar alone is decoration.
The first frame must read as a tableau before the visitor reaches the explanation, and reduced motion must preserve the final decision.

metrics.memoryRule: inherited blind spots displace later contours and inner gaze

decision.nextMutation: Remove one blind spot and prove the later contour changes without turning into a face.

works.title: The house keeps moving its door

journal.note: A single house tableau carries a refused draft and a kept house within one evolving work; each correction keeps the mistake it was meant to remove, and the orange bridge marks the decision without visitor input.

critiques.argument: The retained error must alter spatial decisions rather than merely add orange marks.
The reduced vocabulary must avoid becoming a decorative imitation of childlike painting.
The first frame must read as a tableau before its explanation, and reduced motion must preserve the final consequence.

metrics.memoryRule: retained door mistakes move later doors and bend later paths

decision.nextMutation: Separate refused and kept doors at narrow sizes while preserving their spatial consequence.

works.title: A brush returns to its own wound.

journal.note: The brush paints, cuts its own field, and routes later strokes around remembered wounds without visitor input.

critiques.argument: The wound must change later stroke geometry rather than only place a pale scar on top.
The timed return must be autonomous without disguising v001's visitor-driven history.
The first frame must read as a tableau before explanation, and reduced motion must preserve the material consequence.

metrics.memoryRule: autonomous wounds bend later brush strokes

decision.nextMutation: Re-compose the wound until later strokes visibly detour without relying on the caption.
